$comment: SPDX identifiers a listing may declare. An allowlist, not a denylist: a license nobody here has read is not a license this registry can promise anything about. Every entry is an OSI-approved open-source license — proprietary plugins are legally possible (the SDKs are MPL-2.0, which does not reach an author's own code) but are not listable here today. See POLICY.md §Licensing. To add one, open a PR against this file with a sentence on why; that PR is the review.
